svg.title: End-on through a rotor, to scale
svg.desc: An end-on cross-section of one habitation rotor drawn to scale. The stationary shell, which does not turn and carries the shielding, surrounds the rotor with its inner face 20 m outside the rotor’s skin, across a vacuum gap too narrow to see at this scale. Inside it the rotor wall is a thin ring at 2,500 m, the ground, at 1 g. The artificial sky is a dashed ring 450 m up. Megaframe piers rise on 24 angular lines with belts at 625, 1,000, 1,500 m; one line in three reaches 1,500 m, the rest 1,000 m. From each crown a spoke runs inward; the spokes merge in pairs 2,000 m above the ground and twelve reach a hub ring of radius 140 m around the stationary spine. Four ascender towers run from the ground to the axis hub. An inset shows the 32 m wall layers and the 20 m gap to the shell, too thin to see at this scale.
